Name: VM Resize Links (vmscale)
Description: The linked-resource actions an `az vm resize` PUT revalidates: write the attached managed disks, join the attached NIC. Held by ee-vmscale-operator-oidc alongside Virtual Machine Contributor on the web VM. Grants no create, no delete, no read, and nothing on the NSG. __SUB__ and __RG__ are substituted at apply time -- see docs/runbooks/vm-scaling-setup.md.
